title: 🔆🔅Beijing - November 2nd, 2026 - Ali Bagheri made remarks after a meeting with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Beijing.
text:
🔆🔅Beijing - November 2nd, 2026 - Ali Bagheri made remarks after a meeting with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Beijing."

"============"

"SOT1, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy secretary for Iran's Supreme National Security Council: "The Islamic Republic of Iran and the Republic of China share views on many international and regional issues, and we have endeavored during this trip to transform these common elements into arenas and spheres of cooperation between the two countries; well, this requires discussion and consultation between the two sides.""

"SOT2, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy secretary for Iran's Supreme National Security Council: "The esteemed President of China recently presented a four-point initiative for establishing security in the region, and we emphasized that, in any case, many of its components are compatible and consistent with the views and principled positions of the Islamic Republic of Iran in this arena. One of those components of the Chinese initiative is the issue that the destabilizing factor and the root of insecurity in the region is the Zionist regime.""

"SOT3, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy secretary for Iran's Supreme National Security Council: "We believe that any initiative, design, or arrangement in the region that does not take into account this main factor, namely, the so-called crisis-creating nature of the Zionist regime and the issue of the rights of the Palestinian people, will be futile and will not reach fruition.""

"SOT4, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy secretary for Iran's Supreme National Security Council: "Foreign countries should not interfere or have influence in regional security mechanisms. Well, it is obvious that what has caused instability in the region over past years, especially at the present juncture, is the interference of the American regime as well as the expansionism of the Zionist regime. Therefore, in our view, this perspective of the Chinese can also be helpful in creating and making the arrangements that can establish sustainable security in the region.""

"SOT5: "In meetings with Chinese officials, including the Chinese Foreign Minister, it was clearly stated that China supports the Islamic Republic of Iran's approach in defending its interests, security, sovereignty, and its territorial integrity against the aggression of the United States and the Zionist regime, and considers these two regimes to be the actual cause of this war.""

"SOT6: "In this meeting, it was emphasized that China also supports the approach of the Islamic Republic of Iran in the diplomatic arena and considers the United States to be the factor disrupting understandings and agreements. Therefore, in fact, the initiatives presented by the Islamic Republic of Iran at this juncture have also been supported by the Chinese. In my opinion, this is a very important issue, as in the coming period we share a common perspective between the Islamic Republic of Iran and the People's Republic of China on both the issue of war and diplomacy.
